purpose: Read-only source discovery and bounded service validation; no runtime or global changes.
assessment: West Bengal’s official Banglarbhumi portal exposes mouza-map and plot-map services, and the state urban property workflow selects district/block/mouza and uses land/registration databases. However, no Dhulian-specific mouza/map availability result, exact point-to-mouza match or local parcel registry response was obtained. The Dhulian municipal map found is an administrative map, not a cadastre. No full parcel polygons were retained.
